correctness.rationale: Rows of a reflexive Ł-transitive relation are open. Arbitrary infima of their nilpotent strong powers give principal unit-cut upsets; pointwise constant functions and arbitrary joins reconstruct all unit-cut monotone functions. In the finite/uniform-gap case, the exact least row exponent is the ceiling inverse gap, with sharp grid examples. The necessity difference has a direct pointwise upper bound and single-off-point valuation giving each edge lower bound. A countable counterexample with fractional degrees tending to one establishes the need for complete meets in the unrestricted case. Exact finite-grid verification passed every frame enumerated in the specified finite domains; these computations are not substituted for general proof.

value.rationale: This is an exact completion theorem for the natural Kripke-generated fuzzy Alexandroff space under a logically motivated extra closure operation. It identifies which relational information survives, gives a sharp worst-case semantic distortion, a constructive least uniform finite-power cutoff, and a countable obstruction explaining why complete Alexandroff meets matter. This structural result and its exact boundaries are not a mere renaming of a fuzzy-preorder/topology correspondence or routine numerical recomputation.
